resources.string: For now, all of this stays on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere yet. When your parent connects the phone to their Belay server, Belay will send this there, including the app changes it noticed before.
Belay sends this to your parent\'s Belay server at %1$s, and nowhere else. It doesn\'t send anything that isn\'t on this list.
Belay isn\'t sending any of this right now, because this phone was disconnected from your parent\'s Belay server. It stays on this phone.
Connected to your parent\'s Belay server at %1$s.
The last try to reach the server didn\'t work. Belay will try again by itself.
Not connected to a Belay server yet.
Your parent connects this phone to their Belay server, with a QR code or a short code from it.
This phone was disconnected from Belay.
Your parent\'s Belay server doesn\'t accept this phone anymore, so Belay stopped sending. Your parent can connect it again.
Connect to your parent\'s Belay server
Your parent\'s Belay server shows a QR code and a short code on its \"Add a phone\" page. Scan the QR code, or type the server\'s address and the code.
Point the camera at the QR code.
Belay uses the camera only on this screen, only to read the QR code. Nothing from the camera is saved or sent.
When you leave this screen, Belay turns off its own camera access, and Settings shows that.
Belay can\'t use the camera, so it can\'t scan. You can type the server and the code instead.
The camera isn\'t available. You can type the server and the code instead.
That QR code isn\'t from a Belay server. Scan the one on your parent\'s \"Add a phone\" page.
This phone is now connected to your parent\'s Belay server at %1$s. The server calls it \"%2$s\".
That doesn\'t look like a server address. It should look like belay.example.org.
A code has 8 letters and numbers, like 7KQ2 M9XA.
The server didn\'t accept that code. It may have a typo, it may have been used already, or it may be more than 30 minutes old. Your parent can make a new one.
There were too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Belay couldn\'t reach the server. Check the address, and that the phone is online.
Something answered at that address, but it isn\'t a Belay server. Check the address.
The server turned the request down. Belay or the server may need an update.
The server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
This phone is already connected to a Belay server. Only your parent can change that.
Something went wrong on this phone. Try again. If it keeps happening, your parent can check Belay.
Until your parent turns it back on.

resources.string: These apps are new, so they stay paused until your parent says yes. You can tell your parent why you want each one.

Belay will ask your parent as soon as it can reach their Belay server.
Tell your parent why you want this app
Sent. You can change it and send it again.
Belay will send it as soon as it can reach your parent\'s Belay server.
Your parent wants to talk with you about it.
These apps are hidden and can\'t open. You can ask your parent about one.
Your parent chose these rules. Here is what each one means.
Your parent hasn\'t turned on any rules yet.
Belay never blocks calling or texting 911 or 988. Call 911 in an emergency. 988 is the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: you can call or text it any time you need someone to talk to.
New apps wait for your parent.
When you install an app, it stays paused until your parent says yes.
Safe mode would stop Belay from running.
You can\'t add other users to this phone.
Another user wouldn\'t have these rules.
You can\'t install apps from downloaded files or other app stores.
The Play Store checks apps for harmful software first.
You can\'t set up a VPN.
A VPN could get around the phone\'s website settings.
The phone looks up websites through %1$s, which your parent chose.
It keeps the phone\'s website settings the way your parent set them.
You can\'t change the date, time or time zone.
Changing the clock could end a pause early.
You can\'t change your default apps.
Belay always lets the default phone and texting apps work, so they stay the ones your parent set up.
You can\'t add or remove accounts.
The accounts on this phone stay the ones your parent set up.
Adding a phone plan is up to your parent.
You can\'t reset the phone from Settings.
A reset would erase the phone and remove Belay.
After a reset, the phone asks for your parent\'s Google account.
That\'s factory reset protection: only your parent can set the phone up again.
Developer options and USB debugging are off.
With them, a computer could change this phone\'s settings around these rules.
Until then, the phone can be connected to a computer to fix something.
Your parent turned off apps for browsing the web.
Websites for adults are filtered out
Only the websites your parent allowed open
Belay stops being the device owner. Debug builds only: you can then uninstall it without a factory reset.
